name: dynamic storage retains deep and cyclic graph identity
source: function main(): void { const root: number[][] = []; const first: any = root; let cursor: any = first; for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) { const next: any = []; cursor[0] = next; cursor = next; } cursor[0] = first; let read: any = root; for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) read = read[0]; console.log(read === cursor, read[0] === root); const other: number[][] = []; const second: any = other; second[0] = first; first[1] = second; const identity: any = new Function("value", "return value"); console.log(first[1][0] === first, identity(first) === root); }
